name: Café Zupas (Draper / Riverton / Logan) Wisconsin Cauliflower or Tomato Basil Soup & Soft Roll
brandOrRestaurant: Café Zupas (12300 S Draper, Riverton/Herriman & Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Right down the street from TownePlace Suites Draper on 12300 S (and in Riverton & Logan): Zupas blends their Wisconsin Cauliflower and Tomato Basil soups completely smooth and serves every meal with a soft white bread roll.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a bowl of Wisconsin Cauliflower Soup, Tomato Basil Soup, or Chickpea & Vegetable/Chicken Noodle Soup with the soft white roll (take a Lactaid for the cream/cheese base, and give away the seeded chocolate-dipped strawberry if flaring).
watchOuts: Every Zupas meal comes with a chocolate-dipped strawberry—skip the strawberry if avoiding achenes/seeds during a flare
